title: Grand Slam Tennis Review (Wii) | Nintendo Life
snippet: Along with entries in EA's venerable Tiger Woods PGA Tour and Sega's Virtua Tennis franchises, the MotionPlus launches alongside EA's first tennis offering since 1994, the Wii-exclusive (for now) Grand Slam Tennis.

title: Grand Slam Tennis: What's Hot and What's Not Preview - Wii - Operation Sports
snippet: It’s hard to believe that during the 15-plus years of success by the EA Sports brand only one tennis game has ever been released under the North American label: IMG International Tour Tennis for the Sega Genesis, which debuted in 1994 and received little fanfare and a lukewarm critical reception. This time around, while critical reception for Grand Slam Tennis will be delayed until the game actually comes out, the fanfare surrounding Grand Slam Tennis for the Nintendo Wii already outweighs the hype surrounding its forgotten ancestor on the Genesis.
